open_points.subject: plan_run mapped-list value reading
open_points.text: A mapped node's elements are the positions of a non-empty list delivered to its map_over port, counted from the JSON array its StoredValue holds — read with read_value_bytes, or the canonical_json of an AssembledList not yet written — or the files of its SpooledFilesRef;
open_points.other_text: - StoredValue fields (exact, no others exist): value_id: str, value_digest: str, carriage: Carriage, media_type: str | None, value_schema: str, disclosure_class: DisclosureClass, size_bytes: int
open_points.question: Must StoredValue gain a field containing the JSON bytes, or must the note say to construct an appropriate ByteSource from its value_id before calling read_value_bytes?

open_points.subject: plan_run element sources from flow inputs
open_points.text: Each element's sources are one per input port in port name order: a RecordedSource for a flow input's StoredValuesRef, a constant's StoredValuesRef or the output ref of an unmapped succeeded node on the enabled edge — from its NodeExecution or its ElementSucceeded outputs —;
open_points.other_text: - Run fields (exact, no others exist): run_id: str, flow_version_id: str, pinned_implementations: tuple[PinnedImplementation, ...], inputs: tuple[PortRef, ...], outputs: tuple[PortRef, ...], status: RunStatus, cancelled_by: Actor | None, waiting: tuple[WaitingPoint, ...], started_by: Actor, started_at: KernelInstant, ended_at: KernelInstant | None, resumptions: tuple[Resumption, ...], released_by: Actor | None, released_at: KernelInstant | None
open_points.question: Must Run.inputs be restricted to StoredValuesRef, or must plan_run preserve any permitted PortRef when constructing a RecordedSource?

open_points.subject: plan_run flow outputs reached directly from flow inputs
open_points.text: A flow output's source is formed the same way; an output reached by an edge straight from a flow input is a RecordedSource of that input's StoredValuesRef (A13 rule 3).

open_points.question: Must Run.inputs be restricted to StoredValuesRef, or must a direct flow-output source use the input's declared PortRef?
